command:
$rd = "$env:USERPROFILE\flip-scanner-runner"
"=== STATE FILE ==="
$sf = Join-Path $rd ".runner-state"
if (Test-Path $sf) { "state=" + ((Get-Content $sf -Raw).Trim()) } else { "state file MISSING" }
"=== RUNNER GIT LOG (last 6) ==="
git -C $rd log --oneline -6 2>&1 | Out-String
"=== RUNNER GIT STATUS ==="
git -C $rd status -sb 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 3
"=== LOCAL RESULT FILES ==="
Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $rd "pc-inbox") -Filter "result-*.json" | Select-Object Name, LastWriteTime | Out-String
"=== PC-RUNNER PROCESSES ==="
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='powershell.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like "*pc-runner.ps1*" } | Select-Object ProcessId | Out-String
"=== DONE ==="
